snippet.title: Island of Hearts | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The Island of Hearts demo is out now on Steam! Step into a first-person love story filled with heartfelt moments, awkward encounters, and just the right amount of chaos. Will you fall for the fiery rebel, the shy artist, the confident leader — or someone who completely derails your emotional stability?

On this island, love isn’t just in the air — it’s in every questionable decision you make.

Wishlist "Island of Hearts" on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3794770/Island_of_Hearts/
